C13T1P1.title: Case Study: Tourism New Zealand website
C13T1P1.content: 旅行者用网站收藏景点并在新西兰地图上规划行程。
C13T1P1.scene: A visitor at a laptop follows a bookmarked itinerary on a recognisable two-island New Zealand map. Landscape thumbnail and turquoise alpine lake behind the screen rhyme visually. The website and route are the main subject.

C13T1P2.title: Why being bored is stimulating — and useful, too
C13T1P2.content: 抄电话簿后的发散思考，用实验中的泡沫杯表现无聊与创造力。
C13T1P2.scene: Close cropped overhead, a half-filled page of tedious handwritten telephone-number marks and the open directory fade to grey; opposite them, a single white tapered foam cup with luminous possibilities in its cast shadow, such as a planter and telephone receiver. Hold the cup as one silhouette. Warm butter and ultramarine, curious and quiet.

C13T1P3.title: Artificial artists
C13T1P3.content: “绘画傻瓜”程序自己生成树林与天空，点出计算机能否创作艺术的争论。
C13T1P3.scene: Foreground hand-sized digital painting of soft trees and sky blossoms out of the pixel grid of an early desktop display. Pixel edges halfway across the painting give way to expressive brushstrokes. Frame this as a gallery visitor peering at computer-made art, not a stock humanoid robot.

C13T2P1.title: Bringing cinnamon to Europe
C13T2P1.content: 肉桂内树皮制成的卷条和锡兰海港相连，点出香料进入欧洲的贸易历程。
C13T2P1.scene: A Sri Lankan cinnamon peeler's hands hold a curling tawny quill of inner bark at a wooden waterfront table; beyond them one period square-rigged trading ship heads past palms to sea. The curve of bark drives the composition. Burnt cinnamon and pale Indian Ocean turquoise, historically observed cloth and timber.

C13T2P2.title: Oxytocin
C13T2P2.content: 从实验参与者相互观察、作出选择的场景，呈现催产素作用随社会情境而变。
C13T2P2.scene: A spare social-psychology lab: two adult volunteers across a game table judge one another's expressions before moving a token. A third person quietly records results. Cool lilac and warm ochre split across the same exchange. Faces and uncertainty are the subject; no hearts, spray, drug advertisement or promise of trust.

C13T2P3.title: MAKING THE MOST OF TRENDS
C13T2P3.content: 以经济低迷时期的手包设计为例，呈现品牌如何回应消费趋势。
C13T2P3.scene: In a leather-goods design studio a designer places a playful colourful poppy-patterned handbag alongside a restrained traditional luxury bag. Only these two large shapes, swatches and a thoughtful hand on an uncluttered cutting table; economical screen-printing, no logos, prices or text.

C13T3P1.title: The coconut palm
C13T3P1.content: 一枚椰子同时表现出能漂浮的果实和可制成绳索的纤维层。
C13T3P1.scene: A sharply observed half coconut at the foreground waterline, coarse husk fibres visible beside a length of coir rope; behind it a whole green-brown fruit rides a small ocean wave, a palm shore in the far distance. Botanical field plate, layered blues and warm straw, no tiny captions.

C13T3P2.title: How baby talk gives infant brains a boost
C13T3P2.content: 面对面说婴儿语的照护者和婴儿，表情与声音轮廓体现夸张的语调。
C13T3P2.scene: Tight intimate profile of an awake baby making eye contact with a caregiver who is talking expressively, with a single soft rising-and-falling arc travelling between them. Luminous domestic morning, anatomically careful, contemporary editorial drawing. Speech interaction, not feeding or posed family portrait.

C13T3P3.title: Whatever happened to the Harappan Civilisation?
C13T3P3.content: 来自古湖沉积物的螺壳帮助重建哈拉帕城市时期的水文变化。
C13T3P3.scene: A researcher's palm holds a slender conical freshwater snail shell above a thin column of lake sediments, matching the line of a distant ochre Indus brick settlement and its dry perimeter. Archaeological natural-history editorial, shell and ancient bricks the two legible shapes, no fantasy ruin or certain claim about why people left.

C13T4P1.title: Cutty Sark: the fastest sailing ship of all time
C13T4P1.content: 卡蒂萨克号以帆力和速度运货，聚焦船体、索具和茶运时代。
C13T4P1.scene: Heroic low broadside of Cutty Sark, a long slim black-hulled nineteenth-century three-masted British tea clipper, square-rigged with cream sails filled by wind and a long bowsprit, slicing dark green seas. A very small tea chest on dock in the foreground. Ship anatomy and speed, not naval battle, modern yacht or steam.

C13T4P2.title: SAVING THE SOIL
C13T4P2.content: 用表层土中根系和土壤生物的剖面，表现土壤健康与退化。
C13T4P2.scene: A farm field cutaway: dark crumbly topsoil teems with fine roots and visible soil life, tapering into paler compacted, eroding ground. Above, a living crop and a farmer's boot give scale. Dense earth as hero, no magnified giant organisms, warm umber versus fresh green; elegant science-journal opener.

C13T4P3.title: Book Review
C13T4P3.content: 围绕《幸福产业》的核心争论，呈现把主观幸福化为可测量指标的想法。
C13T4P3.scene: A reader looks over a blank-covered book; a brass survey instrument in sharp foreground tries to measure the curve of a human smile reflected in its mirror. The gap between lived feeling and numerical measurement is palpable. Graphic, sophisticated muted pink and charcoal; no smiley emoji or book-cover lettering.

C12T1P1.title: Cork
C12T1P1.content: 工人从仍然生长的栓皮栎上剥取厚树皮，交代软木从哪里来。
C12T1P1.scene: A Portuguese cork harvester gently eases a thick naturally curved sheet of bark away from a living cork oak at chest height. Show deep dark fissured bark above and warm red exposed trunk below, leafy mature tree and open Mediterranean grove. Close side view with textured hands, bark the hero. No felled logs.

C12T1P2.title: COLLECTING AS A HOBBY
C12T1P2.content: 用按主题整理的邮票册表现收藏带来的分类、知识和乐趣。
C12T1P2.scene: A collector uses blunt stamp tongs to place a single vivid postage stamp into a page arranged by subject; close overhead, a fountain of small bird and maritime motifs held within one orderly album. Historic perforations clearly visible, no legible lettering or brand. Ink ultramarine and vermilion.

C12T1P3.title: What’s the purpose of gaining knowledge?
C12T1P3.content: 以大学消防科学课程的调查案例，表现知识的用途与伦理选择。
C12T1P3.scene: A university fire investigator and a student observe a charred room through a doorway, holding a field notebook; an evidence photograph rests on the open book. Focus on careful interpretation and purpose of knowledge, after the event. No flames, technical methods or ignition equipment. Deep umber and cream.

C12T2P1.title: The risks agriculture faces in developing countries
C12T2P1.content: 小农面对天气和价格双重风险，田地与市场在同一画面相接。
C12T2P1.scene: A smallholder at the edge of a patchwork farm weighs a grain sack on a market balance. Behind, one side of the field lies dry under sun while the other gathers heavy rainclouds. Market uncertainty and weather share the same horizon; respectful eye-level composition, no text or poverty stereotypes.

C12T2P2.title: The Lost City
C12T2P2.content: 梯田、山脊和石屋展现马丘比丘，也让读者知道当地居民早已熟悉此地。
C12T2P2.scene: A local guide leads a travelling researcher onto a misty Andean ridge, looking down across the recognisable terraced masonry of Machu Picchu, steep Huayna Picchu rising behind. People small enough not to obscure the stonework. Early twentieth-century expedition, local knowledge respected; no gold city or fantasy temples.

C12T2P3.title: The Benefits of Being Bilingual
C12T2P3.content: 用原文的记号笔与邮票实验，表现两种语言在同一时刻被激活。
C12T2P3.scene: The viewpoint of an eye-tracking study: at a clean lab table a bilingual participant reaches toward a marker pen but glances sideways at a large postage stamp. Gaze, pen and stamp form one bold triangle. Flesh tones, cobalt and warm ivory, no flags, text, brain icons or speech bubbles.

C12T3P1.title: Flying tortoises
C12T3P1.content: 幼年加拉帕戈斯象龟装入定制运输箱，随直升机飞往岛上放归地。
C12T3P1.scene: A Galápagos park warden carefully lifts a juvenile domed giant tortoise next to a custom vented cargo crate at the OPEN REAR DOOR of a landed rescue helicopter. Volcanic lava ground, cactus forms and a misty island ridge. The crate travels INSIDE the helicopter. Natural history reportage, no airborne dangling turtles.

C12T3P2.title: The Intersection of Health Sciences and Geography
C12T3P2.content: 地图上的病例分布表现健康地理学如何研究疾病的空间差异。
C12T3P2.scene: From directly above, a health geographer places small coloured case markers on a large river-and-neighbourhood map; the cluster follows one side of town, a clinic in the far edge of the map. An elegant narrative of spatial evidence in teal, coral and cream. No readable place names, numbers or generic medical cross.

C12T3P3.title: Music and the emotions
C12T3P3.content: 演奏中的悬念与听众的期待，呈现音乐如何引发情绪。
C12T3P3.scene: One violinist suspends the bow a breath before resolving a phrase; just beyond, a listener leans forward eyes closed, fingers curled in anticipation. The lit bow makes a single luminous arc through a deep indigo concert hall. Evoke expectation as much as sound. No floating musical notes or anatomical brain.

C12T4P1.title: The History of Glass
C12T4P1.content: 黑曜石和人工吹制器皿，展现玻璃从天然材质到工艺品的发展。
C12T4P1.scene: A jagged black obsidian shard in the immediate foreground beside a glowing glass vessel taking shape at the end of an artisan's blowpipe in an old workshop. An elegant visual rhyme between the edges and highlights connects natural and crafted glass. Saffron furnace light, soot black, translucent turquoise.

C12T4P2.title: Bring back the big cats
C12T4P2.content: 带耳簇的欧亚猞猁出现在英国林地边缘，呼应文章讨论的再引入。
C12T4P2.scene: A solitary Eurasian lynx at the edge of a British woodland clearing, tufted ears, short black-tipped tail and spotted coat accurate. Its watchful gaze leads towards browsing deer in the far understory. Naturalist gouache, mist and muted heather. An envisioned reintroduction, not a safari or predation scene.

C12T4P3.title: UK companies need more effective boards of directors
C12T4P3.content: 董事会在眼前财务指标与长期治理之间作决策。
C12T4P3.scene: Overhead view of a British boardroom table: directors turn from a small pile of quarterly charts towards a large long-term plan laid across the table, one chair empty amid the discussion. Collegial but searching expressions. A single late-afternoon shadow bridges short and long horizons, no legible chart text.

C11T1P1.title: Crop-growing skyscrapers
C11T1P1.content: 剖开设想中的城市垂直农场，让人一眼看见摩天楼每一层都在种庄稼。
C11T1P1.scene: Large cutaway of a plausible vertical farm tower nested into a real city skyline: planted rows on repeated indoor floors, a grower tending leafy crops behind glass; ordinary buildings beside it give scale. Seen slightly from below, late-afternoon greens against smoky apricot. An architectural proposal, not a fantasy future.

C11T1P2.title: THE FALKIRK WHEEL
C11T1P2.content: 运河船在水平水槽里随福尔柯克轮升至高架渡槽。
C11T1P2.scene: Architecturally faithful Scottish Falkirk Wheel from the side: the iconic two curved Celtic-axe arms rotate around one axle carrying two opposing water-filled level gondolas, one small narrowboat inside; the high concrete aqueduct enters from the right and a lower basin below. No Ferris cabins, no observation wheel. Strong structural silhouette, steel blue and bright stone.

C11T1P3.title: Reducing the Effects of Climate Change
C11T1P3.content: 以遮阳设想呈现地球工程应对升温的思路，画面明确是被讨论的设计。
C11T1P3.scene: A scientist's large open conceptual drawing shows a small swarm of translucent sunlight-deflecting screens between the Sun and a curved Earth, two elegant light rays bent aside. The hand holding the translucent drawing makes clear this is a proposed design. Deep space navy, copper light and pale ice; no numbers or oversized permanent installation.

C11T2P1.title: Raising the Mary Rose
C11T2P1.content: 水面上出现木船残存的一舷以及贴合船身的打捞托架。
C11T2P1.scene: The 1982 raising of the Mary Rose: the surviving dark timber half-hull emerges from grey Solent water, supported inside a large steel recovery cradle slung by a crane. Water streams from exposed ribs, tiny hard-hatted salvage crew show scale. No intact Tudor galleon or sails. Museum-grade historical maritime illustration.

C11T2P2.title: What destroyed the civilisation of Easter Island?
C11T2P2.content: 用扶绳“走”石像的复原设想，引出复活节岛文明史的不同解释。
C11T2P2.scene: A reconstruction of upright Rapa Nui moai transport: a few teams pull ropes from either side of ONE standing basalt statue, slight tilt hinting at walking it upright on grassland; coastal Rapa Nui horizon. Frame it like a modern archaeological model on a table with its edge visible, not a historical certainty. Ochre earth, sea blue.

C11T2P3.title: Neuroaesthetics
C11T2P3.content: 抽象画和观众的视线轨迹，表现研究者如何探究审美反应。
C11T2P3.scene: A gallery visitor in profile studies a bold original abstract canvas. A faint, sparse path of eye fixations crosses the colours on a transparent research overlay, linking looking and aesthetic response. Use an original composition, not a reproduction of an identifiable painting. Crisp vermilion and rich blue.

C11T3P1.title: THE STORY OF SILK
C11T3P1.content: 从蚕茧引出的丝线延伸到织物，叙述丝绸的来历。
C11T3P1.scene: Extreme close-up of ivory silkworm cocoons on a mulberry leaf; a fine glinting filament leads into shimmering folded silk in the background, with a simple wooden reel partly visible. Material transformation is the story. Botanical gouache in jade, silk cream and warm wood, no captions or historical caricature.

C11T3P2.title: Great Migrations
C11T3P2.content: 以必须穿过狭窄地带的叉角羚群说明迁徙路线的重要性。
C11T3P2.scene: Low, sweeping view of migrating American pronghorn funnelling through a narrow opening between two Wyoming mountain slopes, then stretching out across open country. White rump patches, forked short horns and slim tan bodies distinguish pronghorn. The corridor itself forms the focal shape; no wildebeest or random animal collage.

C11T3P3.title: Preface to ‘How the other half thinks: Adventures in mathematical reasoning’
C11T3P3.content: 把两组奇数圆片拼成成对的圆片，表现读者能亲自跟随的数学推理。
C11T3P3.scene: Hands slide two groups of coloured counters into pairs on a quiet tabletop. Exactly three ochre counters and five teal counters regroup as four unmistakable pairs, two rows, four columns. Spare editorial mathematical illustration for general readers; no digits, equations, decorative symbols or chalkboard.

C11T4P1.title: Research using twins
C11T4P1.content: 借一对近似的面孔和不同生活环境，表现双胞胎研究的比较思路。
C11T4P1.scene: Two adult identical twins sit at the same wooden research table, recognisably alike but in different clothing and postures; their reflections line up in a narrow mirror as a researcher compares the pair's records. Empathetic naturalistic faces, restrained indigo and peach; no mismatched ages or simplified genetic conclusions.

C11T4P2.title: An Introduction to Film Sound
C11T4P2.content: 同一扇门的轻响，在电影画面与混音台之间产生叙事效果。
C11T4P2.scene: A film sound mixer subtly raises a fader; on the dark screening-room projection a close-up shows a hand opening a door, its bright latch almost echoing the slider. Just these two linked details, foreground mixing desk / background movie frame. Noir charcoal, dim amber; no gun, action scene or score symbols.

C11T4P3.title: ‘This Marvellous Invention’
C11T4P3.content: 借有限的语音组合成丰富表达，表现语言本身这一“发明”。
C11T4P3.scene: Two people converse face to face; a handful of simple repeated phonetic-shape tiles flow from one mouth and recombine in midair into densely varied ordered patterns. Restrained, sophisticated visual metaphor for sound combinations and meaning. Graphic ink with deep plum and persimmon, not a typewriter, alphabet poster or machine.

C10T1P1.title: Stepwells
C10T1P1.content: 阶梯通向地下水面，突出印度旱区阶梯井的取水功能和建筑形式。
C10T1P1.scene: Elevated diagonal view into Chand Baori in Rajasthan: three walls of the deep square tank are packed with interlocking zigzag stone stairways; a single figure descends toward the small green water surface at the bottom. One pavilion glimpsed at the edge, parched sun above, cool shadow below. Architectural precision, no fantasy palace.

C10T1P2.title: European transport systems 1990–2010
C10T1P2.content: 欧洲货车、公路和铁路并行，表现文中关于交通方式平衡的讨论。
C10T1P2.scene: From a European valley overpass one sees a motorway of freight lorries running beside an electrified railway carrying containers; both converge toward a city. A single moving train contrasts with the slow queue without making a numerical claim. Moody slate, ochre and red, period around 2000; no logos or high-speed maglev.

C10T1P3.title: The psychology of innovation
C10T1P3.content: 年轻设计师在同一张桌上回应彼此的点子，呈现群体对创新的影响。
C10T1P3.scene: In an early 1980s Italian design studio, young designers add radically different shapes and laminate samples to a single colourful geometric furniture prototype. A hand begins adjusting a surprising curved component as another person offers an idea. Show the social process behind innovation; original Memphis-inspired object, no copied iconic chair.

C10T2P1.title: Tea and the Industrial Revolution
C10T2P1.content: 茶壶与英国工业城镇同框，引出喝茶与工业革命之间的历史假说。
C10T2P1.scene: Steam rises from a plain tea kettle and a filled cup at an eighteenth-century British mill window; the same curve leads visually to brick factory chimneys and a mill wheel beyond. Historic domestic ceramics and light, smoky blue with copper. Suggest a historical question, never a pictured medical cure or proof.

C10T2P2.title: Gifted children and learning
C10T2P2.content: 学生给自己的解题思路作标记，在教师引导下学习监控学习过程。
C10T2P2.scene: A young learner pauses over a spatial puzzle, moving colour counters and sketching a second strategy in the margin. An attentive teacher sits slightly back and lets the child plan. Tight view of attentive faces and hands, sunlit turquoise and ochre. No genius-lightbulb icon, rankings or celebration.

C10T2P3.title: Museums of fine art and their public
C10T2P3.content: 原作前的观众与手中的复制品形成呼应，表现美术馆观看经验。
C10T2P3.scene: Over the shoulder of a museum visitor holding a small reproduction postcard, framed against the far smaller-than-expected original Mona Lisa in a quiet gallery. Match postcard and distant pose, but original uses subtle painterly suggestion; architecture and the act of looking dominate. Walnut, lapis and diffused skylight.

C10T3P1.title: The Context, Meaning and Scope of Tourism
C10T3P1.content: 车站带动集体旅行，体现大众旅游的兴起及其跨行业特征。
C10T3P1.scene: A Victorian British excursion train pulls into a coastal station; travellers with small luggage step from the platform toward a seaside lodging and promenade. Steam arch unites railway, accommodation and destination. Warm travel-editorial colour and an instantly readable scene of organised tourism, not a generic airplane.

C10T3P2.title: Autumn leaves
C10T3P2.content: 同一根枝条上向阳的红叶与遮阴叶片，呈现秋叶变红的研究问题。
C10T3P2.scene: A botanically credible autumn branch seen against low sun: a richly red sun-facing leaf overlaps a shaded leaf, its fine veins and angled light strikingly clear. A forest canopy in soft distance; present the sunscreen idea as a question through composition. Cadmium red, amber and deep green, no explanatory text.

C10T3P3.title: Beyond the blue horizon
C10T3P3.content: 带有印纹的拉皮塔陶片与太平洋海岛，同框呈现古航海者的考古证据。
C10T3P3.scene: Foreground archaeological hand holds a weathered Lapita potsherd with dentate geometric impressions; its jagged edge frames a small distant voyaging canoe beyond the blue Pacific horizon. Volcanic island profile, authentic small artefact, discovery and voyaging in one image. No modern Polynesian festival or map arrows.

C10T4P1.title: The megafires of California
C10T4P1.content: 加州林地与住宅交界的火场，呈现干燥植被和城市扩展带来的风险。
C10T4P1.scene: A wide California wildland–urban interface, dry chaparral and forest climbing one ridge, a small residential edge at its base. Behind the ridge the sky turns orange from an enormous distant wildfire; a firefighter surveys from a safe overlook. Serious reportage with layered smoke, no how-to, no house explosion.

C10T4P2.title: Second nature
C10T4P2.content: 透过一个人刻意练习面对畏惧场景，呈现性格品质可以培养的论点。
C10T4P2.scene: A nervous adult waits at the edge of a small public-speaking platform with practice cards, then squares their shoulders toward a listening audience. Illuminate the hands and first step into light, not a triumphant victory. Quietly hopeful teal and amber, no split personalities or exaggerated fear.

C10T4P3.title: When evolution runs backwards
C10T4P3.content: 用不同近缘蝾螈的脚趾形态，表现演化特征消失后再出现的问题。
C10T4P3.scene: Natural-history field illustration focuses on close views of slender salamander forefeet, positioned as two lifelike comparative specimens on moss and damp leaf litter. Their differing toe arrangements, not dinosaurs or a backwards arrow, carry the evolutionary question. Fine anatomy, copper and moss green; no invented diagram labels.

C9T1P1.title: William Henry Perkin
C9T1P1.content: 紫色染料染上丝绸，表现珀金的偶然发现如何改变纺织业。
C9T1P1.scene: Victorian dye research studio: a young man resembling William Henry Perkin holds deep mauve silk to daylight, a second length of once-white fabric lifted with it. Rich purple reflections fall over dark glassware and a window. Focus on the accidental colour and the textile, not a chemical recipe.

C9T1P2.title: Is there anybody out there? The Search for Extra-terrestrial Intelligence
C9T1P2.content: 大型射电望远镜朝向星空，表现研究者搜寻地外无线电信号。
C9T1P2.scene: A real-looking radio telescope dish sweeps a star-filled sky; in the dim observatory foreground a researcher examines an irregular signal trace against noise. Show patient listening, not an alien, UFO, or confirmed detection. Vast midnight indigo and a thin line of mint instrument light.

C9T1P3.title: The history of the tortoise
C9T1P3.content: 海龟的鳍状前肢与陆龟的承重前肢，交代科学家推断古龟栖息环境的依据。
C9T1P3.scene: A museum comparative specimen tray, large fossil forelimb outlines beside carefully observed forefeet of a terrestrial tortoise and flipper of a sea turtle at true relative scale. Forelimbs are the focal evidence; secondary pool edge and dry earth echo the two habitats. Naturalist ink, sage and slate.

C9T2P1.title: The impact of hearing loss on young children
C9T2P1.content: 教室里教师的声音和其他声音相互遮蔽，呈现听力损失给学习带来的困难。
C9T2P1.scene: Eye-level with a primary pupil at their desk concentrating on the teacher's face; scraping chair and nearby children's conversation are suggested by two restrained overlapping acoustic ripples which weaken the sightline to the teacher. Sensitive inclusive New Zealand classroom, no caricature or oversized hearing apparatus.

C9T2P2.title: Venus in transit
C9T2P2.content: 金星以一个小黑点经过日面，呼应历史天文观测对天文单位的测量。
C9T2P2.scene: One large safely projected golden solar disc on an eighteenth-century astronomer's white screen, Venus a tiny sharply defined black dot inside it; the antique telescope casts a long shadow beside the projection apparatus. No one looks straight into the Sun. Restrained historical science painting, deep navy and gold.

C9T2P3.title: A neuroscientist reveals how to think differently
C9T2P3.content: 同一个物体换个视角看，轮廓呈现不同意义，直观呈现打破惯常认知。
C9T2P3.scene: An inventor rotates a single folded three-dimensional paper object under an angled lamp; its striking unexpected shadow makes a second readable shape. The face and hands show a moment of fresh perception. Original visual metaphor for seeing past habitual interpretation, not an illustration of a claimed lab test. Coral and deep petrol.

C9T3P1.title: Attitudes to language
C9T3P1.content: 观察人们怎样说话的记录与规范性修改同框，体现对语言的两种态度。
C9T3P1.scene: Two people studying the same living conversation from opposite sides of a café table: one carefully takes a field transcript as a speaker gestures, the other annotates a printed grammar page with a red pencil. Slender pencil and open listening posture create the contrast. No readable invented words or national flags.

C9T3P2.title: Tidal Power
C9T3P2.content: 海底水轮机利用潮流发电，水面与水下的剖面把潮汐能表现清楚。
C9T3P2.scene: A cutaway through a British tidal channel: beneath the moving dark teal surface, a single submerged turbine on a fixed seabed support turns with the horizontal current; shore and small sea bird above. Instantly readable underwater rotor and water flow. No wind farm or hydroelectric dam.

C9T3P3.title: Information theory – the big idea
C9T3P3.content: 旅行者号微弱的深空讯号跨越噪声抵达地球，表现信息论解决的实际问题。
C9T3P3.scene: Voyager spacecraft with its high-gain dish in dark space at left sends a faint orderly train of signal marks across noisy interference toward a distant terrestrial receiving dish. The marks remain abstract, no letters or equations. Huge separation and the idea of recoverable information, deep ultramarine and amber.

C9T4P1.title: The life and work of Marie Curie
C9T4P1.content: 居里在工作室研究沥青铀矿，呈现其对放射性矿物的早期研究。
C9T4P1.scene: Historically observed Marie Curie in her turn-of-the-century Paris workroom examines a dark lump of pitchblende near a period measuring instrument, daylight on her focused face. Mineral is dull black and unlit, never fluorescent neon. Restrained charcoal, brown and pale blue; no procedure diagram.

C9T4P2.title: Young children’s sense of identity
C9T4P2.content: 幼儿看着镜中的自己、触摸自己脸上的记号，表现自我识别。
C9T4P2.scene: A toddler looks into a low, safe mirror and touches the small red mark on their own nose. The reflection matches hand, face and red spot accurately rather than reaching into the glass. A caregiver barely visible at the edge. Tender developmental-psychology editorial in pale blue and warm terracotta.

C9T4P3.title: The Development of Museums
C9T4P3.content: 从密集的陈列柜到有情境的展示，呈现博物馆观看体验的变化。
C9T4P3.scene: From behind two visitors an old densely packed museum showcase gives way to an immersive reconstruction of a historic street, opened like a theatre set into the gallery. One case and one life-sized contextual scene, clear before-and-after visual idea. Warm museum light, no futuristic holograms.

C8T1P1.title: A Chronicle of Timekeeping
C8T1P1.content: 日晷投影与机械钟摆形成呼应，交代从自然周期到机械计时的发展。
C8T1P1.scene: A stone sundial casts a crisp triangular shadow; beside it the brass pendulum of a historic clock makes an answering arc. Strong single shafts of sun, minutely observed materials, understated museum-editorial style. No digital clock or impossible repeated numerals.

C8T1P2.title: Air Traffic Control in the USA
C8T1P2.content: 塔台与雷达屏幕中的航迹，交代美国空中交通管制怎样组织空域。
C8T1P2.scene: From inside a US control room a radar operator studies two sparse green routes on a dark screen, a commercial jet visibly climbing through the tower window over the runway. Ordered separation of aircraft, realistic proportions and clear sightline; no crash, martial imagery or frantic dashboard.

C8T1P3.title: Telepathy
C8T1P3.content: 用分隔开的发送者、接收者与目标图片，表现文章讨论的超感知实验设计。
C8T1P3.scene: A university psychology lab shown as two separate adjacent rooms. A sender looks at one target picture; in the next room the seated receiver wears smooth translucent eye covers and headphones. A clear, solid wall between them; quietly observed test setup, no mystical light, telepathic beams or claim of proven powers.

C8T2P1.title: Sheet glass manufacture: the float process
C8T2P1.content: 平整的玻璃带浮在锡液上成形，表现浮法玻璃工艺的关键创新。
C8T2P1.scene: Close side-on industrial cutaway: an unbroken ribbon of hot glass spreads perfectly flat across a silvery molten tin bath and emerges horizontally towards rollers, cooling from amber glow to clear blue. Single strong horizontal gesture. Accurate broad relationship, not a bottle-blowing workshop or complex diagram.

C8T2P2.title: The Little Ice Age
C8T2P2.content: 欧洲山谷中冰川与旧农田近在咫尺，交代小冰期对生活的影响。
C8T2P2.scene: Historical Alpine valley during the Little Ice Age: an advancing glacier tongue lies close to farm fields and a modest European village below. People and a hay cart for scale, mountain snow and a pasture green in the same scene, showing variable climate rather than ice covering all Europe. Muted blue-green woodcut.

C8T2P3.title: The Meaning and Power of Smell
C8T2P3.content: 一种熟悉的气味唤起人与过去的联结，表现嗅觉的心理与社会作用。
C8T2P3.scene: Someone lifts a familiar folded linen garment and breathes in; a warm, softly bounded memory of its owner appears in the contour of the cloth. Specific human connection through smell, no visible stink lines, perfume bottle or disembodied giant nose. Painterly dusky terracotta and ivory.

C8T3P1.title: Striking Back at Lightning With Lasers
C8T3P1.content: 科研人员探索如何用激光引导雷电，画面聚焦防雷研究的设想。
C8T3P1.scene: A wide observational science illustration of a distant thunderstorm over an isolated mountain, scientists behind a sheltered research-station window watching one faint upward trace and a bright natural lightning channel in the distance. Clearly depicted as an outdoor research question, not weaponry. No labelled apparatus or operating details.

C8T3P2.title: The Nature of Genius
C8T3P2.content: 以学者比较不同童年和成长记录，表现如何研究杰出成就及其来源。
C8T3P2.scene: A scholar at a light table compares several very different childhood sketchbooks, music manuscripts and mathematical notebooks, looking for patterns behind exceptional adult achievement. A single open, well-used notebook under their hands is the focal object. Text marks illegible, avoid a magical glowing brain or caricature of a prodigy.

C8T3P3.title: How Does the Biological Clock Tick?
C8T3P3.content: 用生命周期长短不同的生物表现衰老与寿命的“生物钟”，扣准原文的时间尺度。
C8T3P3.scene: An immense old tree trunk in cross section with dense growth rings fills the frame, beside a tiny short-lived mammal on the forest floor. A living-systems editorial on differing life spans and ageing, deep russet, moss and ivory. It concerns a lifetime, not circadian sleep, a clock face or a day/night cycle.

C8T4P1.title: Land of the Rising Sum
C8T4P1.content: 日本普通数学课上，学生比较不同解法，体现集体课堂的教学方式。
C8T4P1.scene: A Japanese lower-secondary mathematics classroom: rows of individual desks face a blackboard where two pupils compare concise geometric solutions under the teacher's guidance. View from one pupil's seat, a triangle and different construction lines legible as shapes. Natural school day, no decorative caricatures or tiny invented writing.

C8T4P2.title: Biological Control of Pests
C8T4P2.content: 用文章中的象甲与水葫芦水道案例，表现用天敌控制有害生物。
C8T4P2.scene: Botanical macro of a small brown aquatic weevil perched on one glossy water hyacinth leaf with its characteristically swollen stalk; in the background a narrow Kerala waterway is crowded with floating hyacinth. Precise visible ecological relationship, no chemical spray, laboratory protocol or release instructions.

C8T4P3.title: Collecting Ant Specimens
C8T4P3.content: 蚂蚁研究人员在野外从落叶层观察、收集标本。
C8T4P3.scene: An entomologist lifts a little forest leaf litter over a white collecting tray. A hand lens magnifies one anatomically accurate six-legged ant as other tiny ants become visible against the white. Documentary natural-history illustration, brown leaves and vermilion accents, no cartoon ant society.

C7T1P1.title: Let's Go Bats
C7T1P1.content: 蝙蝠依靠回声估计猎物的位置，画面表现发声和回声的往返关系。
C7T1P1.scene: At twilight an insect-eating microbat wheels toward a moth. One restrained pair of wavefronts travels from its open mouth to the moth and back toward its large ears. Side-lit wing membrane and tiny insect make echolocation readable within a second. No fruit bat, radar dish or daylight hunt.

C7T1P2.title: Making Every Drop Count
C7T1P2.content: 灌溉用水从水渠送抵作物根部，表现从扩大供水转向有效利用。
C7T1P2.scene: In a dry cultivated valley water moves from a reservoir canal through a simple irrigation line toward the roots of one thriving row. Broad blue channel versus carefully delivered droplets, grower checking the plants. Conservation and allocation of water, no giant tap in empty space. Terracotta and dusty blue.

C7T1P3.title: Educating Psyche
C7T1P3.content: 教师边播放巴洛克音乐边朗读，表现文中讨论的暗示教学法。
C7T1P3.scene: In a modest late twentieth-century language classroom a teacher reads aloud from an open text while a record player with a spinning disc plays baroque music. A relaxed group of adult learners listens; close crop on speaker, record and listening faces. Plum, ochre, wood grain. No guru or supernatural symbolism.

C7T2P1.title: Why pagodas don’t fall down
C7T2P1.content: 剖开日本木塔，露出心柱与层层屋檐，呈现抗震结构。
C7T2P1.scene: A Japanese five-storey timber pagoda shown partly cut away, the single continuous central wooden shinbashira visible inside the separately stacked wide-eaved floors. A subtle lateral sway suggested by a single offset contour. Precise timber joinery, pale vermilion, indigo and natural cedar. No Chinese stone pagoda or collapse.

C7T2P2.title: The True Cost of Food
C7T2P2.content: 廉价食物的货架价格与农田产生的环境成本同框，呼应文章的实际账单。
C7T2P2.scene: A shopper places a modest basket of food on a grocery scale. Its long shadow opens onto a farm valley and the river receiving agricultural run-off, subtly linking the checkout cost to environmental costs. One clear visual connection, sober editorial print, no price text, villains or sensational pollution.

C7T2P3.title: Makete Integrated Rural Transport Project
C7T2P3.content: 坦桑尼亚马凯特乡间，手推车和改善后的步道体现与当地出行需求相适应的方案。
C7T2P3.scene: Residents in Tanzania's green highland district of Makete move produce on a locally made wooden single-wheel barrow along an improved footpath. A distant steep carrying route explains the problem. Eye-level, dignified and practical, carefully drawn wooden equipment. No urban highway or safari imagery.

C7T3P1.title: Ant Intelligence
C7T3P1.content: 切叶蚁分工搬叶和照料地下菌圃，是文章比较蚂蚁与人类社会的具体例子。
C7T3P1.scene: A side cutaway of a leafcutter ant colony: a neat file of ants carries bright cut leaf fragments across the ground above, leading into an underground chamber with a pale spongy fungus garden. Scientifically credible tiny six-legged ants, cross section instantly legible. Observation, no microbiology equipment.

C7T3P2.title: Population Movements and Genetics
C7T3P2.content: 牙齿形态作为人群迁移研究的一种证据，与北太平洋地理相对照。
C7T3P2.scene: A researcher gently compares casts of molars with distinct crown features on a study tray, a relief map of northeast Asia, Bering Strait and Alaska lying behind. The tooth casts and narrow sea crossing are the key shapes. No human racial caricatures, migration arrows stated as certainty or real human remains.

C7T3P3.title: Protecting Europe’s forests
C7T3P3.content: 林务人员在固定样地测量、记录树木，表现欧洲森林监测合作。
C7T3P3.scene: Two European forest surveyors on a long-term monitoring plot check tree crown condition through binoculars and record observations beside a numbered-looking but text-free trunk marker. Tall beech canopy opening to sky, red survey tape and an ochre field notebook. Clear monitoring action, not a lumber operation.

C7T4P1.title: Pulling strings to build pyramids
C7T4P1.content: 现代研究者用大型风筝试立石柱，文章讨论的是实验验证的设想。
C7T4P1.scene: A modern field experiment, visibly contemporary: a single large fabric kite pulls a rope over a simple high frame as a heavy stone column slowly tilts upright. Tiny helmeted researchers keep distance. Kite, taut line and tilting stone form one clean triangle. No ancient Egyptians flying kites, completed pyramid or instructions.

C7T4P2.title: Endless Harvest
C7T4P2.content: 阿拉斯加鲑鱼洄游和渔业监测同框，交代“源源不断的渔获”从何而来。
C7T4P2.scene: In an Alaskan river a strong returning salmon in clear water fills the foreground; a fisheries observer counts the run from a small riverbank station, with a working fishing boat at the estuary. The fish moves inland, not out to sea. Slate water, spruce green, silver salmon.

C7T4P3.title: Effects of Noise
C7T4P3.content: 用噪声中完成任务的实验参与者，呈现噪声是否可预测对注意力的影响。
C7T4P3.scene: An adult subject concentrates on a simple tracking task at a psychology lab table while a speaker to one side emits irregular bursts, shown by subtly uneven waves. Hand, simple task and restrained tired expression are primary. No giant ears, heavy machinery or hearing injury. Strong ochre, black and soft teal.

C6T1P1.title: AUSTRALIA'S SPORTING SUCCESS
C6T1P1.content: 澳大利亚体育科学家用影像分析游泳动作，将成绩与运动科学联系起来。
C6T1P1.scene: Half-submerged side view down an Australian high-performance swimming lane. A freestyle swimmer's arm breaks the surface as an underwater camera records the stroke; on deck a coach compares the captured form on a screen. Clean pool geometry, cobalt and burnt orange, athletic anatomy and no Olympic logos.

C6T1P2.title: DELIVERING THE GOODS
C6T1P2.content: 同一个标准集装箱在货船与陆地运输之间转运，表现现代货运的变革。
C6T1P2.scene: A red intermodal shipping container hangs from a standard spreader under a dock crane, passing from a container ship toward waiting rail wagons. Reduced geometric ship, rail and container silhouettes read at phone size. Trade logistics not a travel poster. Industrial navy, terracotta, early morning.

C6T1P3.title: Climate Change and the Inuit
C6T1P3.content: 因纽特社区观察海冰变化，表现气候变化对实际出行与本地知识的影响。
C6T1P3.scene: An Inuit elder and a younger community member in modern practical winter clothing assess a crack across a familiar sea-ice travel route in Nunavut. One gestures to the changing surface while the other listens, with the Arctic settlement low on the horizon. Respectful northern daylight, no polar bear or stereotyped igloo.

C6T2P1.title: Advantages of Public Transport
C6T2P1.content: 以珀斯通勤铁路和道路交通并列，表现城市公共交通的取舍。
C6T2P1.scene: A commuter railway in Perth, Western Australia, runs between the two sides of a busy freeway, a single passenger train moving along a legible corridor past suburban development. Eucalypts, bright Perth light, accurate scale, no Sydney Opera House or European tram. Teal, ochre and pale sky.

C6T2P2.title: Greying Population Stays in the Pink
C6T2P2.content: 老年人独立处理日常事务，呈现长期研究所发现的健康变化。
C6T2P2.scene: Two older adults out shopping independently in their neighbourhood; one carries light groceries up a few steps while the other chats easily. Respectful mature faces with realistic wrinkles rather than heroic marathon athletes. Warm daylight, domestic detail, unshowy vitality. No promise that ageing prevents disability.

C6T2P3.title: Numeration
C6T2P3.content: 用手指与一组实物一一对应，表现计数概念的形成。
C6T2P3.scene: An overhead study of hands counting a small set of pebbles: one fingertip aligns with each object in a row on a simple surface, another hand adds a pebble. Immediate tactile one-to-one correspondence, natural hands and believable digit count. Ochre stone, dark indigo. No abacus collage or Arabic numerals.

C6T3P1.title: The early history and impact of cinema
C6T3P1.content: 早期无声电影中驶向摄影机的列车与银幕前的观众同框。
C6T3P1.scene: In a small 1890s film screening, silhouetted spectators look up as a steam locomotive approaches diagonally on the projected station-platform scene. Keep the projector beam and silver screen unmistakable: a film being seen, not a train actually entering the room. Sepia image, warm lamp, deep charcoal.

C6T3P2.title: Motivating Employees under Adverse Conditions
C6T3P2.content: 主管和员工一起选择具有意义的目标与反馈，表现逆境中如何激励不同的人。
C6T3P2.scene: In a modest workplace during a downturn a manager listens closely to one employee as together they lay out achievable project milestones using plain cards. Tight focus on collaboration and a card the employee chooses, muted workplace in background. No trophies, oversized money or fake motivational slogan.

C6T3P3.title: The Search for the Anti-aging Pill
C6T3P3.content: 研究者在探索延缓衰老的可能性，以实验假说与待验证的药物为主题。
C6T3P3.scene: A gerontology researcher looks through a glass partition at a healthy laboratory mouse while an unmarked pill shape remains out of focus on sketches on the desk. Quiet inquiry and uncertainty; never an advert, dosage chart or before-and-after transformation. Refined clinical light, pale lavender and warm grey.

C6T4P1.title: Doctoring Sales
C6T4P1.content: 医药代表向医生展示资料，呈现药品信息与销售之间的关系。
C6T4P1.scene: A pharmaceutical representative in business clothes opens a sample case and an unbranded brochure across a doctor's desk. The physician listens critically with a pencil in hand; an ordinary clinic door behind. Focus on conversation and commercial context, no pills prescribed, legible product names or caricatured corruption.

C6T4P2.title: Do Literate Women Make Better Mothers?
C6T4P2.content: 尼加拉瓜成年女性识字学习与家庭健康资料，交代文章比较的研究问题。
C6T4P2.scene: A Nicaraguan woman reads a simple illustrated child-health leaflet with her young child beside her; in the background an adult-literacy class meets around a table. Mother as capable active participant, respectful realistic setting. Hands and leaflet make the reading connection clear, no moral judgement or medical outcome claim.

C6T4P3.title: Bullying in schools
C6T4P3.content: 把受排挤的学生与伸出援手的同学、倾听的教师放在同一校园场景里。
C6T4P3.scene: At a school corridor bench a pupil who was isolated is quietly invited to join two peers while a teacher crouches to listen. Achieve the emotional shift with posture, space and eye contact. An empathetic editorial image about spotting and addressing bullying; no graphic abuse or caricatured bully.
